description.value: Great Dane Coffee is a family-run cafe on the UBC campus, founded in 2012 by mother-and-son team Toni and Andrew, built around house-made food and locally sourced ingredients including Brightside Beans espresso. The shop bakes its own focaccia bread for a range of sandwiches and produces daily pastries such as scones, cinnamon buns, and croissants. Set beside Gage Towers with a patio and large windows, it offers an off-the-beaten-track feel along with online ordering for quick pickup.
